newsitem.title: UK: Policewoman hurt in suspected IRA attack.
newsitem.headline: Policewoman hurt in suspected IRA attack.

text.p: A Northern Ireland policewoman was shot and wounded in a suspected IRA guerrilla attack in the city of Londonderry on Thursday, police sources said.
The sources said the shooting happened near the city's court house shortly before 1600 local (1500 GMT).
No further details were immediately available.
"We have first reports of a shooting incident. A woman officer has been injured," a police source said.
The Irish Republican Army (IRA) has been fighting a 28-year war to end British rule of Northern Ireland and reunite the province with the Irish republic.
